submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the token that completes a locally stereotyped multi-token construction licensed by the preceding 1-2 tokens: the keyword closing a loop header ('For i in'), a negation after a modal ('would not', 'can not'), the second half of a fixed collocation ('not guilty'), or a time/quantity word pinned by its frame ('Friday at', 'at 100'). Breaking the construction's first half collapses the peak even when the peak token itself is unchanged, so activity tracks the predictability of the chunk, not just peak-token identity.
